errors.text_span: 参数量为17M时MR约为83.2%，19M时约为83.5%，22M时约为83.8%，25M时约为84.0%
errors.evidence: The description states MR values as 83.2%, 83.5%, 83.8%, 84.0% respectively, but the figure shows approximately 83.1%, 83.4%, 83.7%, and 83.5%.
The description lacks mention that the chart shows average MR values across three datasets for different parameter sizes.
The description does not mention the steady increase in MR values with increasing parameter sizes.
